name: MicroID Lab Guide
description_zh: 四階段未知細菌鑑定練習：初步形態、流程分支、生化檢驗選擇、最終候選菌種與矛盾結果確認。提供 67 項檢驗技術與培養基參考。
description_en: Four-phase unknown-isolate identification using morphology, decision trees, biochemical test selection and consistency checks; 67 supporting lab references.
note_zh: 有正式教學論文及公開 GitHub 專案；目前不複製部署，也不視為臨床鑑定系統。原站即時連線狀態可能變動。
note_en: Peer-reviewed educational project with public source; linked externally only, not clinically validated. Live app availability may vary.

name: Ontario Tech Virtual Lab
description_zh: 以操作影片、培養與鏡檢照片及檢驗決策路徑，模擬細菌鑑定流程；錯誤選擇可返回重做。
description_en: Virtual clinical-microbiology workflows with videos, photographic test results and identification decision trees.
note_zh: 教學原站有著作權；本站只連結，不轉載影片與圖片。
note_en: Provider-owned multimedia; link rather than republish.

name: BacDive API Test Finder
description_zh: 依 API 生化反應陽性／陰性組合搜尋相符的菌株資料，輔助理解生化試驗鑑別能力及菌株差異。
description_en: Filter strain records by positive and negative biochemical/API test results to learn identification patterns and strain-level variation.
note_zh: 呈現的為資料庫菌株原始資料，可能與教科書典型反應不同；不能直接當成臨床菌種鑑定結論。
note_en: Strain-level raw data can vary; not a validated clinical species identification output.

name: MediaDive
description_zh: 查培養基名稱、成分、配製配方與關聯菌株；含 medium finder、builder、單位換算等工具。
description_en: Search culture medium recipes, ingredients and strain associations; includes medium builder and unit conversion.
note_zh: 以官方資料庫及實驗室 SOP 為準，不等同現行臨床標準作業指引。
note_en: Reference database; follow local validated laboratory methods.

name: Mycology Online
description_zh: 醫學重要真菌形態、鑑定檢索表、黴菌自我測驗及抗黴菌感受性參考。
description_en: Medical mycology descriptions, mould identification keys, self-assessment and antifungal susceptibility references.
note_zh: 網站圖片多為 CC BY-NC，但部分屬第三方著作；本站僅外部連結，不自動重製。
note_en: Many images use CC BY-NC, but third-party exceptions exist; link only.

name: EUCAST MIC & Zone Distributions
description_zh: 查微生物／藥物配對的 MIC 和抑菌圈直徑分布、ECOFF 相關參考數值及圖表。
description_en: Explore species–antimicrobial MIC and zone-diameter distributions, ECOFF-related data and histograms.
note_zh: 聚合分布不代表抗藥率，不可比較國家、時間或不同藥物的抗藥率；臨床 breakpoint 請另查官方表格。
note_en: Aggregated distributions do not estimate resistance rates; clinical breakpoints are published separately.

name: WHONET 2026
kind_zh: 免費 Windows 分析軟體
description_zh: 臨床微生物資料管理、AST／antibiogram 分析與抗藥性監測；官方提供 Windows 版本及 BacLink。
description_en: Windows application for microbiology laboratory data, AST interpretation, antibiograms and AMR surveillance.
note_zh: 免費使用不等於開源；學生應用匿名或合成資料練習，並確認適用的 CLSI／EUCAST 年度。
note_en: Free-to-use is not automatically open-source; use de-identified or synthetic datasets and appropriate standards.
